lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Another job well done.
Don't mention it.
I saw that you prepared a reception for us. Thank you for that.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It's the least I could do considering all that you've done for us. Hardly worth thanking me for.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: With a bit more time, I'll be able to show my gratitude more emphatically.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Now then, let's discuss the results of your latest expedition on the surface.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: First off, tell me about Cinderella and Grave.
They're both our allies.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I can see that with Grave,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: but I have a harder time believing that with Cinderella.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: In the past, she...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Never mind. It's all in the past.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: There's no way to know what happened between then and now.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Time changes many things.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Since she helped you with the Heretic operation, I'll consider her trustworthy.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: For now, their existence remains classified. Very few people are aware of them.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: But secrets don't last forever.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It's only a matter of time before other Deputy Chiefs like Burningum catch wind of it.
But I thought they wouldn't be able to make moves on us like before.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That's half true.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: If Burningum is willing to make some sacrifices, however, things won't be much different from before.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We'll have to think long and hard about how to proceed.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: For now, continue operations with those two.
Understood.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Next is the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Ingrid. What happened with the samples?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We can't bring them into the Ark, so after Absolute secured them, they were sent to a temporary research facility on the surface.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We're analyzing their components, but it will take some time before any conclusive results are available.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Considering that it's the main power source for the Four Beasts, we need to get to the bottom of this.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I realize that.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Moving forward,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: uncovering the Four Beasts' objective is our top priority.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: They have been operating covertly on the surface for a long time, and they've made significant progress.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: They activated the Harmony Cube by rerouting the electricity from the Crystal Region and are currently building an Ark elsewhere.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: They've also managed to create something called Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Given their name, we can be fairly certain that there are four of them in total.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's therefore reasonable to assume there are two more entities utilizing materials similar to the crystals and Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Once we identify what the Four Beasts have created, we'll be able to figure out what they're after.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Whatever their plans are, I'm certain it's not small-scale.
We'll continue to focus on
exploring the surface and actively engaging with Heretics.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Very good.
I would like to tell you something in regard to that.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: What is it?
I would like for Vapaus ammunition to be made in the Ark.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... What is the meaning of this?
I'm unable to reach Eden at the moment,
and I believe that Vapaus-based ammunition will be indispensable for future battles.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Right... Considering that getting your blood on one of the Heretics accelerated their transformation,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: using your blood in its unadulterated form carries a risk that's far too high.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, what exactly does this mean for us?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It sounds as if your blood is the key component used in manufacturing Vapaus. Is that true?
That's right.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I began to have some vague suspicions once I discovered that Rapi doesn't have a NIMPH,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but I hardly expected for your blood to be Vapaus.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I'm sure you must have a compelling reason for bringing this up when Ingrid is present.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Tell me what it is you want to do.
I want to entrust the refinement of Vapaus to Elysion.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Can you do that, Ingrid?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Let's go draw blood immediately.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: While I appreciate your enthusiasm, there are a few practices you must adhere to.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Yes, I know. I'll handle it all with the utmost secrecy.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'll only involve individuals I know I can trust.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Very well. I have complete faith in your abilities.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I will wait for you in the car.
Ingrid quickly leaves the room.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yikes, if looks could kill! Andersen doesn't look too pleased.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, it's kinda freaky seeing someone who's usually so composed look like that.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Neon, you shouldn't judge a person based on their appearance.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... You do realize the key part of gossiping behind someone's back is not doing it in front of them?
Allow me to apologize on their behalf.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It was brave of you to reveal what you just did.
I couldn't rely solely on Eden.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Keep bolstering your power and reputation.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: As for my end, it seems like I'm going to have a lot on my plate.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I'm not sure if you realize this, but most of what you do is highly classified.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It's not easy trying to keep everything under wraps.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You say that, but you seem rather pleased.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Hehe, guilty as charged.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: As an old retiree who still wields a modicum of power,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: having a task to focus on is a joy.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Just don't be reckless.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Your social standing has increased, so most things that come your way can be deflected.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: For now, however, it would be best to keep a low profile.
Understood. Thank you.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Have you thought about which area you'll be exploring next?
I have a place in mind.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Go on.
I unfold the map given to me by Raptilion,
and point to a specific spot on it.
Here.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: And the reason?
It's been blotted out in black, which I initially thought signified that this part of the map hadn't been finished.
But after seeing Dark Matter with my own eyes, my perspective changed.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... There is a high possibility that it's an ocean or some other large body of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Leviathan's habitat, perhaps.
It's very probable, yes.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Good. Then that will be the next destination.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Considering how troublesome that area has been in the past,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I'll assign reinforcements whom I know can be discreet, and will be immune to brain scans.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You're welcome. You may go now.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Ingrid is waiting for you.
Deputy Chief.
What about the matter that I reported to you earlier?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Right. That.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're joking, right?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No, it's true.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Raptures are not infinite.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What are you talking about?! Since when?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Since about a century ago.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's when I cut off the station where the Queen resides, with a beautiful flair.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Therefore, Raptures will no longer come down from space.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Station... as in space station?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Come on, be honest. You're pulling our leg.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Cinderella does not lie.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's right. Why would I do something as ugly as utter untruths?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander...
... It's hard to believe.
We've always believed that the supply of Raptures was inexhaustible.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's unfortunate that none of you met Grave and me sooner.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: A long time ago, I made a machine that kept a tally of the number of Raptures.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It's been too long, and I don't remember how to make it.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: However, I do remember one thing vividly:

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It always displayed an infinity symbol,

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: but after Cinderella went to space,

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: that symbol changed to a concrete number.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, I think it would be best to share this information with the Deputy Chief.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm not sure what our next move should be exactly, but I do think this is worth investigating.
All right, I'll do that.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I've analyzed the rate of Rapture encounters over the past 100 years.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: In the past, there was practically no variation.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Encounters consistently occurred with 100% certainty within an hour of being on the surface.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: However, after averaging the data from the past five years,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: it takes approximately 75 minutes before an encounter is guaranteed.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That confirms that the rate of Rapture encounters has gradually decreased, albeit rather slowly.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: In other words...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are... Are their numbers actually decreasing?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That seems to be the case, yes.
That means...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We still need to follow up on our findings.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It might be that it's only those in close vicinity to the Ark which have decreased in number, or it could be due to differences in their routes and speed.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: There is also a possibility that the data has been compromised for some other reason.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: However, if...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: And this is a big if.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: If it can be proven that Raptures are in fact finite in number,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: then the Ark will be able to weigh options which it never could consider before.
By other choices, do you mean...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Just thinking about it makes my heart flutter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Humanity could ascend to the surface once again.
